h: Isaac Fayose shares photos with Wike's son Joaquin, calls him his younger brother
p: Isaac Fayose, son of former Ekiti governor Ayodele Fayose, has posted photos of himself spending time with Joaquin, the son of FCT Minister Nyesom Wike. He described the young man as his younger brother. The pictures drew lively reactions online.
more: The two fathers are among the best-known figures in Nigerian politics.
Reactions online have mostly been light-hearted.
